open_points.subject: M30 FormFieldRefusalKind delivery to generated code
open_points.text: The release: the form refusal table the data provider holds.
open_points.question: What imported constant symbol names the form-refusal table when generated code reads it?
options: Choose a new constant name derived from the table or row-model name.
consequences: Existing or anticipated imports can keep the former symbol name.
Generated imports, provider exports and notes must consistently use the newly chosen symbol name.
open_points.requirement: The release: the form refusal table the data provider holds.

witness.initial: Generation must emit a module that answers a form failure using the release table.
events: The generator chooses a symbol because the text identifies the table only by description.
One careful implementation imports FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS; another imports FORM_FIELD_REFUSALS.
outcomes: The generated module and provider expose FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS.
The generated module and provider expose FORM_FIELD_REFUSALS.
witness.observer: The build, later note author, or maintainer referring to the imported table sees different required symbols.
